title: Bound from the row-count parameter
statement: For every natural number $n$, set $m=\max\{1,\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil\}$, where the ceiling is the least integer $t$ such that $n+1\le 2^t$. Then $n\le 2^m-1$.
